title: Bi-directional
description: This report is designed to look at the behavior of two directions of a bi-directional corridor. It is set up to show yearly averages for each year of the NPMRDS.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210700, but --from-page could only recover graphType (this page predates _measurePick entirely — every AVL Graph section's measure/resolution/comparisonMode was unrecoverable, flagged _needsReview). Cross-referenced the snap row's route_comps->graphIds (dead elsewhere, but the ONLY routing signal available for this page) against each section's trackingId to determine ground truth: 2 directions (NB=route_slot_group $0, SB=$1) x 7 literal years (2016-2022) x ~2 BarGraphs (Hours of Delay, Travel Time, both 5-minute time-of-day profiles) + 2 RouteCompare + 3 Maps + 2 InfoBox + 2 span('2022-2016') day-resolution bars. Used apply_today_relative_patches.py's own REPORTS[2210700] comp_patches dict as ground truth for the intended date reduction (already-live comp-1/2/11-16 (2016-2019) had already been deleted along with their dedicated 2016 InfoBox/Map sections in an earlier round -- delete_sections succeeded even though comp_patches silently failed, consistent with the split-row dms-raw-update no-op root cause). Reduced 2020/2021/2022 to 2 Years Ago/1 Year Ago/Current Year (yearof/year-1year->1year/year-2year->1year) and the 2022-2016 span route to Trailing 3 Years (year-2year->3year), matching Year Over Year's exact formulas, now split per direction. Two legacy-data issues found and NOT preserved: (1) 'Route Map, Speed' (g3) was fed by ONLY the dropped comp-1 (2016 NB) -- a stale single-comp reference; merged into one real NB speed map fed by all 4 kept NB comps, absorbing the separate '2022, Speed' NB map (g11) which had the same problem in miniature. Same merge for SB (g10 absorbed). (2) The NB Travel Time BarGraph's live graphIds included one SB comp (comp-24) alongside all the NB ones -- the exact 'duplicate label' symptom this page's title already showed literally ('...2021, 2022, 2022'), predating the comparisonSeries-duplicate-label-collapse fix; dropped that stray inclusion, kept the graph NB-only.
